prompt: If somebody was born on the day the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 was signed, how old would they have been while Albert A. Michelson and Edward W. Morley were performing their Michelson-Morley experiment?
answer:
The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 was signed on **August 13, 1814**. The Michelson–Morley experiment was conducted from **April to July 1887**.

Someone born on August 13, 1814, would have been **72 years old** during the experiment, turning 73 afterward on August 13, 1887.
